name: PPG INDUSTRIES, INC.
business: PPG makes architectural, performance and industrial paints and coatings sold to retailers, contractors, automotive, aerospace, packaging and manufacturing customers worldwide.

events.what: SVP and CFO, succeeding retiring Vincent Morales (retirement announced 2025-12-01, 8-K 0000079879-25-000342); missed by the Stage 2 sweep
events.from: Avient Corporation (SVP and CFO); International Paper board

events.what: New General Counsel (internal), Anne Foulkes retiring 2026-08-31

next_event.source: No investor day or framework update found in Baba (company_overview shows only transcripts, filings and 3 expert calls; no Investor Day documents). Next routine event is Q3 2026 results, Beggs's second call as CFO; date not in Baba. CEO Tim Knavish is not new (already President and CEO on the Q2 2023 call, doc 81571), so ceo_months_in_seat is left null rather than guessed; it is well over 18 months.

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: No dated margin target found. The stated algorithm is 2% to 4% organic growth, 8% to 10% EPS growth a year and $1 billion adjusted free cash flow (Knavish, Q2 2025 call), with no margin number. Only numeric margin guide is one quarter: Q3 2026 company adjusted EBITDA margin flat to down 100 bps YoY (Beggs). The caller's 2027 investor-day margin target could not be found or verified in Baba.

statements.quote: We expect third quarter organic sales growth at a range of a low single digit to a mid-single digit percentage, and company-adjusted EBITDA margin, which includes corporate expenses, to be in the range of a flat to a decline of 100 basis points year-over-year.
statements.speaker: Jamie Beggs
statements.doc_title: PPG INDUSTRIES, INC. Q2 2026 Earnings Call

statements.quote: The outcoming of that is we are committed to what I laid out two years ago, which was ongoing. A 2-4% organic growth company that delivers an 8-10% EPS growth every year and a billion dollars of adjusted free cash flow. That's kind of our growth algorithm.
statements.speaker: Tim Knavish
statements.doc_title: PPG INDUSTRIES, INC. Q2 2025 Earnings Call

statements.quote: we expect margin contraction for the segment during the first half of 2026, with margin growth during the second half of the year.
statements.speaker: Tim Knavish
statements.doc_title: PPG INDUSTRIES, INC. Q4 2025 Earnings Call

street.gap_assumption: No stated level, so no gap. VA labels equal calendar years (fyem 12). Consensus already models about +50 bps a year of EBITDA margin expansion (17.14% to 17.63% to 18.19%). LTM margin is Q2 2025 to Q1 2026 VA quarters (Q2 2026 actuals not yet loaded). D scored on the 4-month revision: ebitda_turn_pct -0.2% (FY2027 EBITDA 3,064.0M on 2026-06-30 to 3,057.8M on 2026-10-01).

evidence_of_progress.note: Q1 2026 VA EBITDA margin 17.33% vs 17.18% (+15 bps, data_compute). Q2 2026 actuals not in VA; management reported segment EBITDA margin down 300 bps in Performance Coatings (Refinish), up 100 bps in Architectural to 19.4%, down 70 bps in Industrial to 15.9% (doc 110798), and guides Q3 company adjusted EBITDA margin flat to down 100 bps. Raw materials are petroleum-derived and pricing covered about 90% of COGS inflation in Q2, so margin has some input-cost sensitivity but not commodity-price driven.

verdict: Cheap and de-rated with a new external CFO, but the CEO is long-tenured, no dated margin target is on record, and consensus already builds about 50 bps a year of expansion.
open_questions: Where is the 2027 investor-day margin target the Stage 2 note cites? Not in Baba; ingest the deck if it exists, since it would move C and D.
Will Beggs (ex Avient) bring a cost or margin program with numbers at Q3 or Q4 2026 results?
Is the Refinish margin drop (Performance segment down 300 bps in Q2 2026) cyclical destocking or structural share loss?
